english.title: Landlord of dwelling offered for let allowing unlicensed agent to undertake letting work
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling marketed or offered for let under a domestic tenancy, namely **(..SPECIFY DWELLING..),

(A)_[appointed]_
(B)_[continued to allow]_

a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to undertake lettings work on your behalf in relation to that dwelling when that person did not hold a licence to do so under Part 1 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014 for the area in which the dwelling was located and you knew or should have known that that person did not hold such a licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1) and (3) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
